answer: An identity earns its seat through proof-of-replication with unique encoding per replica, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. Cloning 654 keys multiplies the price 654-fold: 71940 POA locked, or 11118 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. One delta of signal, one velvet of cost, one tide of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
